evidence.title: Plaid’s CFO on Her First Year, and Moving Past ‘Onesie-Twosie’ AI Experiments

occurrences.checkable_against: Plaid software procurement records and contract-review process documentation
occurrences.quote_span: We were previously using a third party to do this, but the team felt they could build something that would rival it and potentially even close some of the gaps that they’d seen.
occurrences.speaker: Seun Sodipo
occurrences.subject: Plaid CFO Seun Sodipo

occurrences.checkable_against: Plaid finance-team project records and software procurement records
occurrences.quote_span: Meanwhile, Sodipo’s finance team has built AI tools to replace third-party software providers.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Plaid CFO Seun Sodipo

occurrences.checkable_against: Plaid benchmarking-tool validation results and comparison with third-party market-data services
occurrences.quote_span: We were able to build a tool that exactly suits our needs, and we felt delivered higher accuracy for the metrics we care more about.
occurrences.speaker: Seun Sodipo
occurrences.subject: Plaid CFO Seun Sodipo

occurrences.checkable_against: Plaid finance-team work schedules and operating records
occurrences.quote_span: For us, it’s easy to look at the numbers and know what that means because that is our day to day.
occurrences.speaker: Seun Sodipo
occurrences.subject: Plaid CFO Seun Sodipo

occurrences.checkable_against: Seun Sodipo's stated priorities and Plaid finance-team operating plans
occurrences.quote_span: Good morning. Plaid CFO Seun Sodipo wants her staff to strike up conversations with company leaders about numbers they’ve crunched in the back office—so much so that it’s been a top priority for her rookie year.
occurrences.speaker: outlet's own
occurrences.subject: Plaid CFO Seun Sodipo

occurrences.checkable_against: Plaid contract-review tool source records, Salesforce records and customer order forms
occurrences.quote_span: A member of our team worked with a cross-functional partner on building a contract review tool that makes sure customer order forms exactly match with Salesforce.
occurrences.speaker: Seun Sodipo
occurrences.subject: Plaid CFO Seun Sodipo
